spans.text: ...The battle ends.
Commander, we've succeeded in bringing back the T-Dolls from the other side!
But none of them have seen the person who contacted us...
Stranger still, even the T-Dolls don't remember who saved them...
So I'm wondering, who on earth were they...
...A small drone lands near the base.
That signal! It's news from the messenger!
I'll go take a look!
Mm..."Caretaker of Caretakers" says that the order with the highest priority is to retreat to the base in Area S11, and stand by for further instructions once we arrive there...
...Something like that.
Gr MP7 really did complete her mission. I hope she's escaped already.
So now we're the only forces still within the contaminated zone...
...Yes, I'll send out the order to get our things ready and move out right away!
Ah...I know it's too early to celebrate now, but still...
When we return to Area S11...when we get everyone back together again...
We'll mount a counterattack some day, right?
...Yeah! I believe that too! Now, let's hurry and move out!
...Meanwhile, in Griffin PMC's HQ.
Berezovich Kryuger.
I am officially placing you under arrest for involvement in the illegal trafficking of arms, the unlawful modification of civilian Dolls, and other crimes.
You have the right to remain silent...
Even if silence is the only right I have. I know.
Mr. Kryuger, I seek your cooperation with us to ensure the process goes smoothly.
...Indeed.
It's all just a process, and it could not be going any more smoothly.
So don't be so nervous, young man. I'm only a criminal, not an enemy.
Kryuger stands up.
Dispense with the formalities. I'm much more familiar with them than you are.
Illegal arms trafficking and unlawful modification of civilian Dolls...
These are pretty good crimes.
When I was still in uniform, I once told Carter that the one thing I didn't want was to be put on trial as a terrorist.
He's a cunning old bastard, but at least he kept his word.
